title: confed push result
description: The `result` of `confed push --json`. With --dry-run nothing is uploaded and the lists describe the plan. `push --interactive` is the one variant with a different shape: cancelling at the prompt returns {"cancelled": true}, and an empty interactive plan returns only the three page lists.

pushed.description: Existing pages updated on the server.

created.description: Pages that had no `confed:` block and were created on the server.

deleted.description: Pages deleted on the server. Only ever non-empty with --allow-delete.

attachments_uploaded.description: Sidecar-relative paths of attachments uploaded, or that a --dry-run would upload.

attachments_deleted.description: Sidecar-relative paths of attachments deleted on the server. Only ever non-empty with --allow-delete.

comments_added.description: Ids of new top-level comments posted: `confed:new` sidecar drafts without `reply-to`, and `<!--c new …-->` marks in page bodies.

replies_added.description: Ids of replies posted (`confed:new reply-to=…`, `confed comment reply`).

comments_resolved.description: Ids of threads resolved (`confed:resolve`, `confed comment resolve`).

storage.description: Only with --dry-run --show-storage: the storage each page body and comment would be sent as.

what.description: page, comment, inline comment on "…", or reply to <id>

comments_pending.description: Comment work a --dry-run found. Absent on a real push, which reports ids in `comments_added`, `replies_added` and `comments_resolved`.

skipped.description: Work push refused: unresolved conflicts, tampered frontmatter, a stale base, or a local deletion (of a page or an attachment) without --allow-delete.

cross_space.description: The pages among `skipped` whose `parent_id` names a page in another space: a move between spaces, which only `confed instance mv` makes. Non-empty means exit 7. Absent when empty.

failed.description: Pages the server rejected. Non-empty means exit 8.

losses.description: --dry-run: each block the edit regenerates whose base holds what Markdown cannot spell, and that the push would drop. Absent when none.

line.description: The block's first line in the page's file.

what.description:
`text colour or font`, `column widths`, `table layout or width`, `styling on

`, `non-breaking spaces`.

pages.description: The same, once per page, sorted by path: what happened to it — or, in a dry run, would — its files included. A script that wants one page's story reads this instead of joining the lists above, which stay.

warnings.description: What the push wants you to know, such as a page whose body went up (or, in a dry run, would) regenerated whole instead of patched block by block. Also in the envelope's `warnings`. Absent when empty.

interrupted.description: Stopped by Ctrl-C (exit 130): the lists say what was done before it stopped, and running the command again finishes the rest. Present only when true.

page_id.description: Empty string for a page created by this very run's dry run.

ops.description: Which aspects of the page change.

parent.description: Under `created` in a --dry-run: the page it would be created under. Both null for the top of the space; `parent_id` null with a `parent_title` for a parent this same push creates.

page_id.description: Absent for a page a dry run would create.

ops.description: Empty when only the page's files or comments changed.

attachments.description: The page's files, by name. Absent when none changed.

skipped.description: Why the page, or one of its files, was held back.
